item.title: Justin Bieber Adds to ‘Swag’ Collection With Live Coachella Album: Stream It Now
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "What's up, music lovers? Welcome to our latest update. If you're a Justin Bieber fan, you're in luck. The Canadian pop star just dropped a brand new live recording from his headline performance at Coachella 2026."
[Short music clip plays]
Host: "The live album, called Swag Live From Coachella (Weekend I), features 22 tracks and guest spots from The Kid LAROI, Tems, Wizkid, Dijon, and Mk.gee. It's a follow-up to his Grammy-nominated album Swag, which debuted at number 2 on the Billboard 200 chart last year."
[Short music clip plays]
Host: "But that's not all. After his Coachella performance, Bieber saw a huge spike in streams, both old and new. In fact, he landed seven albums on the Billboard 200 chart at the same time, a career best. And if you missed his live performance, don't worry. You can catch a repeat of the official livestream on YouTube today at 7pm ET."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "So, what are you waiting for? Stream Swag Live From Coachella (Weekend I) now and get ready to groove to some amazing music. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you in the next one!"
